title: Update on the Physics of the Cosmic Microwave Background (2015-2025)
hook: Cosmology's most important fossil record just got its decade-in-review: a comprehensive update on everything the cosmic microwave background has taught us since 2015.
key_points: This is a book-chapter update to a decade-old review of cosmic microwave background (CMB) physics.
It covers 2015-2025: refined CMB measurements and tighter cosmological parameter constraints.
It tracks how open questions, like the Hubble tension, have sharpened over the decade.
It also previews future prospects for CMB observations.
It's written as a single textbook-style reference for where CMB cosmology stands today.
content_html: According to a new arXiv book chapter by Martin Bucher, cosmology's most important fossil record — the cosmic microwave background (CMB), the faint afterglow of the Big Bang — just got its own decade-in-review. The piece updates an earlier review from a decade ago, cataloging what has changed in CMB physics and observations between 2015 and 2025.
extra_html: The update walks through refined measurements of the CMB's tiny temperature and polarization variations, tighter constraints on the universe's basic parameters, and how the field's biggest open questions — including the Hubble tension — have sharpened rather than resolved over the decade. It closes with a look at future prospects for CMB observations, serving as a single reference point for how the field has moved since the mid-2010s.

related.title: The Cosmic Microwave Background
related.hook: The oldest light we can see is a faint glow filling all of space — released when the infant universe first cooled enough to become transparent, about 380,000 years after the Big Bang.

related.title: The H₀ World Cup II: A Comprehensive Competition Between Proposed Hubble Tension Solutions
related.hook: Fourteen rival theories all claim to fix cosmology's biggest headache — the Hubble tension. A new 'World Cup' pits them head-to-head on the same data to see which ones actually survive.
